views.title: Raft, existing basement and transfer deck
views.desc: The 300 RC raft (SSL-2), the basement walls Ethos have built from the raft to the transfer deck (NOT in this supply - extent to be confirmed) and the SSL-1 composite transfer deck tied into the walls.

views.title: Lower ground walls
views.desc: Lower-ground walls on the deck, 8 courses with the top course cut to 125: the 457 core perimeter in unassembled XR35 panels (corners = two straights lapping, swapping every course), the 8in Std internal walls, the front glazing and doors.

views.title: Ground floor
views.desc: The 400 RC GF slab (SSL0) and the ground-floor 6in XR35 walls (7 courses), windows and the timber stud partitions (heads to the FF deck, stopped under the indicative steels).

views.title: First floor
views.desc: The FF composite deck with the indicative UB steels (engineer), the first-floor 6in XR35 walls (6 courses) to the wall plate, windows and partitions.

views.title: Roof structure
views.desc: Indicative cut roof (no roof plan issued - RFI): hipped crown roof at 32.5 degrees, ridges ~2.4 m above the plate with a flat between them, C24 rafters @600 (truss / engineer design to follow).
